data.description: Embrace the Coastal Lifestyle in the lap of luxury at Emaar Beachfront Dubai.

about.data:
Introducing Address Residences – The Bay.

data.answer:
Emaar Beachfront presents an exceptional blend of upscale living, seaside allure, and metropolitan accessibility, positioning it as among the most sought-after residential enclaves in Dubai.

Residents at Emaar Beachfront enjoy an array of top-notch facilities, such as swimming pools, fitness centers, lush gardens, children's play areas, cafes, restaurants, and retail establishments. This meticulously planned community is tailored to provide its residents with a lavish and hassle-free lifestyle.

Additionally, The Emaar Beachfront location is near various renowned Dubai attractions, including Dubai Marina, JBR Beach, Bluewaters Island, and The Walk at Jumeirah Beach Residences (JBR). This prime location provides residents convenient access to many entertainment, dining, shopping, and leisure opportunities.

Emaar Beachfront enjoys a prime location between Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, affording residents a breathtaking ambiance of the Arabian Gulf, Dubai Marina's iconic skyline, and Palm Jumeirah's distinctive silhouette.

Regarding accommodations, the community showcases an assortment of deluxe residential choices comprising high-rise towers, waterfront apartments, and exclusive beachfront villas. These residences boast contemporary designs and state-of-the-art amenities, ensuring residents experience a chic and cozy living atmosphere.

Properties in Emaar Beachfront

Sunrise Bay at Emaar Beachfront is a popular property in the area. It is a dual-tower complex interconnected by a podium deck and includes a yacht club alongside a selection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments. Another eagerly awaited addition, Grand Bleu Tower Emaar Beachfront is another popular project, the inaugural Emaar Beachfront Elie Saab-designed building globally, offering stunning views of Palm Jumeirah. Noteworthy amenities at Emaar Beachfront include an infinity pool and personalized hotel services at South Beach Emaar Beachfront. For individuals seeking luxurious Emaar Beachfront villas and townhouses, Beach Mansion or Beach Isle presents enticing property options.

Off-Plan Projects in Emaar Beachfront Dubai Properties

Emaar Beachfront Dubai is a rapidly growing community with many projects under development. Here is a list of the off-plan properties included in the Emaar Beachfront masterplan.

Emaar Bayview 2 at Emaar Beachfront

Emaar Bayview 2 offers 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and 5 and 6-bedroom penthouses. These are Address Resort branded residences developed by Emaar Properties.

Elie Saab at Emaar Beachfront

Elie Saab is a collection of luxury residences. The two-tower complex, Grand Bleu Tower & Grand Bleu Tower 2, comprises 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and 4-bedroom penthouses.

South Beach Holiday Homes at Emaar Beachfront

You can find 1 to 3-bedroom Miami-style apartments at South Beach Holiday Homes. A short drive from Sheikh Zayed Road, the holiday apartments provide a perfect investment opportunity. 

Beach Isle at Emaar Beachfront

Beach Isle is a private island that will consist of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and 3 and 4-bedroom Emaar Beachfront villas, Residents can enjoy pristine beaches, breathtaking views, and many luxury amenities.

Address Residences The Bay

Address Residences The Bay consists of branded 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, 3 and 4-bedroom penthouses, and 3-bedroom townhouses. Set at the water’s edge, Address Residences offers an urban style of living.

Beachgate By Address at Emaar Beachfront

Emaar Beachfront is also home to Address Hotels + Resorts-branded residences called Beachgate By Address. These residences offer a collection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses.

Palace Residence at Emaar Beachfront

Explore the 5-star residence at Emaar Beachfront, Palm Jumeirah. Palace Beach Residence consists of two towers, 29 and 42 stories. These apartments include 1 to 3-bedroom waterfront units.

Seapoint by Emaar at Emaar Beachfront

Seapoint by Emaar has 1 to 6-bedroom apartments and penthouses. The amenities include an infinity pool, children’s pool and play area, BBQ areas, cafes, and boutiques.

Emaar Bayview at Emaar Beachfront

The 1 to 6-bedroom apartments and penthouses in Emaar Bayview are the epitome of luxury and sophistication. Bayview by Address Resorts has 23 units offering amazing views of the Arabian Gulf.

Properties for Rent in Emaar Beachfront Dubai Harbour

There are many luxury accommodation options available for rent. Rental properties in Emaar Beachfront are in high demand. Beach Vista, Marina Vista Emaar Beachfront, and Beach Isle are popular Emaar Beachfront apartments for rent.

The rental rates for 1-bedroom apartments in Emaar Beachfront start at AED 110k annually. Similarly, the rental prices for 2-bedroom apartments begin at AED 160k annually. Moreover, larger units, such as 3-bedroom Emaar Beachfront rental apartments, are available for a starting rental price of AED 350k per annum. 4-bedroom flats are rented out at a minimum of AED 725k.

Properties for Sale in Emaar Beachfront Location

Emaar Beachfront Dubai properties for sale offer waterfront living and an array of amenities, making it an excellent investment prospect for potential buyers. The project comprises diverse housing options, including apartments, penthouses, and villas, available in various configurations to cater to individual preferences.

The sales price for 1-bedroom apartments in Emaar Beachfront starts from AED 2.5M.
2-bedroom apartments in Emaar Beachfront are available at the minimum sales price of AED 4M.
The initial cost of 3-bedroom apartments in Emaar Beachfront is AED 6.6M.

Investing in these apartments is an attractive proposition for individuals seeking luxury properties in Dubai, and it is anticipated to yield significant returns. Alternatively, buyers can explore penthouses in Emaar Beachfront, typically located in Beach Vista, Beach Mansion, Beach Isle, and Sunrise Bay Emaar Beachfront.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Emaar Beachfront?

data.answer:
Emaar Beachfront residents enjoy easy access to the pristine beach in Palm Jumeirah, where they go for walks, sunbathe, and engage in water sports. The tranquil atmosphere of the beach provides a serene retreat from the urban hustle and bustle.

Emaar Beachfront offers an impressive range of top-tier facilities, encompassing swimming pools, fitness centers, meticulously landscaped gardens, children's play areas, as well as a variety of cafes, restaurants, and retail establishments. Residents have at their disposal all the essentials for a comfortable and opulent lifestyle right within the community.

Public Transportation in Emaar Beachfront Dubai Properties

Private transportation is the primary mode of travel preferred in the area. To access the mainland, residents can easily drive to the main thoroughfare, Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), which offers direct access.

However, the nearest tram station to the area is Mina Seyahi Tram Station. Additionally, several bus stations are located along the route in Media City, Internet City, and Dubai International Marine Club. Similarly, the Dubai Metro's Red Line network is conveniently accessible at the same distance.

Supermarkets in Emaar Beachfront

Near Emaar Beachfront, several supermarkets are conveniently located, such as Plus Point Supermarket in Sulafa Tower, Caramel Center Supermarket, Atlantis Fresh Supermarket, Uni-Mart, Swiss Mart Supermarket, and Stripes. These options are a 7 to 12-minute drive from the neighborhood. For larger grocery needs, renowned supermarkets like Spinneys and Carrefour in Dubai Marina are easily accessible.

Shopping in Dubai Emaar Beachfront

Given Emaar Beachfront's advantageous proximity to Dubai Marina, numerous prominent malls are within easy reach. These include:

Dubai Marina Mall
Golden Mile Galleria
Nakheel Mall
Dubai Marina Mall, with its impressive array of over 140 shopping outlets and 21 restaurants, provides abundant entertainment opportunities. Visitors can enjoy attractions like The Little Explorers or indulge in a movie screening at Reel Cinemas. Accessible by a quick 10-minute drive from Emaar Beachfront, this mall offers convenience and excitement for residents and visitors alike.

Schools Near Emaar Beachfront

In terms of education, nurseries near Dubai Emaar Beachfront align with those near Dubai Marina, including Monroe’s Nursery, Fun & Play Nursery, and Family and Friends Nursery. These nurseries offer stimulating learning environments following the EYFS curriculum.

For schooling options, iCademy Middle East, Gyanberry Dubai, and The International School of Choueifat are located in Al Sufouh, accessible within a 12 to 14-minute drive from Emaar Beachfront.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Emaar Beachfront Area

Regarding mosques, those near Emaar Beachfront are situated within an 8 to 10-minute drive, including Mohammad Bin Ahmed Al Mulla Mosque, Musabeh Al Fattan Mosque, and JBR Mosque.

Residents of other faiths can find nearby places of worship, such as Seventh-Day Adventist Church, Fellowship: A Christian Church in Dubai, and Coza Church, Dubai, within an 11 to 16-minute drive. Hindu residents can access Shiva Temple, ShrinathJi Temple, and Shiridi Sai Baba Mandir after a 30-minute drive, while Sikh residents can visit Guru Nanak Darbar Gurdwara Dubai in Jebel Ali Village.

Clinics and Hospitals in Emaar Beachfront Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai

Clinics near Emaar Beachfront, like Marina Medical Center, Emirates Hospital Clinic – Marina, and Le Royal Meridien Clinic, are within a 5 to 8-minute drive. Hospitals such as Mediclinic Meadows, Al Zahra Hospital, and Saudi German Hospital offer world-class healthcare services and are reachable within a 13 to 17-minute drive from the neighborhood.

Emaar Beachfront Location & Nearby Areas

Adjacent to Dubai Marina, Emaar Beachfront boasts captivating views of the marina skyline and lies within proximity to Palm Jumeirah, an iconic Dubai landmark. Furthermore, it provides easy reach to Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), renowned for its lively waterfront promenade, bustling dining options, and recreational offerings. This prime location ensures that Emaar Beachfront seamlessly combines beachfront living with urban convenience.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Emaar Beachfront

data.answer:
Emaar Beachfront offers residents and visitors a luxurious beachfront lifestyle. The opulent district enjoys proximity to a variety of leisure, entertainment, and shopping destinations. It is a 16-minute drive away from iconic landmarks such as Ain Dubai, the world's largest observation wheel, and The View at The Palm, a glass-framed observatory in Palm Jumeirah. With easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, the area ensures smooth connectivity to other key areas of Dubai, making it easy for residents to have plenty of fun things to do.

Restaurants near Emaar Beachfront Dubai

Emaar Beachfront is ideally located in proximity to an array of dining places. Marini Restaurant is a fine dining establishment located in the heart of Dubai, renowned for its exquisite cuisine, elegant ambiance, and impeccable service. Another nearby restaurant is Taqado Mexican Chicken in Dubai Media City. It is 14 minutes away from the community and offers a convenient and flavorful dining experience for chicken lovers and Mexican food enthusiasts alike.

For an exceptional fine dining experience, you can also visit Tresind. Situated at a 15-minute drive from the Emaar Beachfront location, the eatery takes your taste buds on a gastronomic journey. The menu features everything from molecular creations to classic Indian favorites with a twist. If that’s not enough, Pier 7 is also located at about the same distance from the area. A popular dining establishment in Dubai Marina hosts seven distinct restaurants, each occupying its floor, presenting an array of culinary delights and dining atmospheres to choose from.

Beaches Near Emaar Beachfront Location

Emaar Beachfront features a stunning 1.5 km stretch of pristine shoreline, open to both residents and visitors. Nearby, Palm Jumeirah Beach, Marina Beach, and JBR Beach are also favored destinations. Accessible within a convenient 9 to 12-minute car ride, these beaches offer varied coastal experiences for all to enjoy.

Hotels in the Emaar Beachfront Dubai Area

Several hotels are located near EMAAR Beachfront Dubai Harbour. The W Dubai—The Palm, Mine Seyahi Beach Resort & Marina, commonly referred to as W Dubai—The Palm, is about an 8-minute drive from the area.

The Dubai Marriott Harbour Hotel & Suites is located about 15 minutes away. The hotel features spacious suites, providing guests with a comfortable and convenient stay. Additionally, it offers a range of dining options, including a rooftop restaurant with panoramic views, a casual café, and a stylish lounge. The Westin Dubai Mina Seyahi Beach Resort & Marina is nestled along the pristine shores of the Arabian Gulf. The hotel offers a luxurious retreat with stunning views of the sea and marina.

Attractions and Landmarks near Emaar Beachfront

Emaar Beachfront enjoys a strategic position in Dubai, granting easy access to numerous attractions and landmarks just a short drive away. Among these notable destinations is Dubai Marina Mall, a mere 5-minute drive from Emaar Beachfront, where visitors can immerse themselves in a diverse array of shopping, dining, and entertainment offerings set against the backdrop of the marina's scenic beauty.

The bustling waterfront promenade of The Walk at JBR, located approximately 10 minutes away by car, presents a lively atmosphere with its abundance of restaurants, cafes, shops, and street performers, ideal for strolls and dining experiences. Bluewaters Island, boasting the iconic Ain Dubai observation wheel, awaits approximately 15 minutes away, offering visitors a chance to indulge in dining, shopping, and entertainment on this captivating man-made island.

Additionally, the Dubai Marina Yacht Club, situated within the vibrant Dubai Marina area, beckons just a 10-minute drive from Emaar Beachfront, providing marina berths, dining options, and recreational facilities for yacht enthusiasts and visitors alike.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Several parks are available for outdoor activities near Emaar Beachfront, including Calisthenics Park, On The Walk, and Dog Park. These options are conveniently located within a 5 to 8-minute drive. Residents can also easily access Skydive Dubai & Cruise Activities.

In addition, residents of buildings in Emaar Beachfront have access to fitness facilities. Notable gyms in the Dubai Marina area include C-Fitness Dubai Marina, NRG Fitness, TK MMA & Fitness, and Club Mina.

Numerous spas and salons, such as Pastels Salon, Ritz Carlton JBR, and NStyle Beauty Lounge, are within reach of Emaar Beachfront for relaxation and beauty treatments.

Despite Emaar Beachfront's convenient access to various attractions and amenities, it might rely heavily on private transportation for daily commuting or accessing services beyond its immediate vicinity. This potential dependence on private vehicles could challenge individuals who favor or depend on public transportation options.

What is Emaar Beachfront's completion date?

Emaar Beachfront by Emaar Properties debuted in January 2018, while the first four towers were completed in 2021.

How many towers comprise Emaar Beachfront?

Like other diverse projects the company developed, Emaar Beachfront features 27 towers, encompassing residential apartment complexes and a hotel.

Is Emaar Beachfront pet-friendly?

Yes, Emaar Beachfront Apartments are pet-friendly, allowing your beloved furry companions to join you in experiencing the luxurious lifestyle it offers.

data.content:
Emaar Beachfront is a luxurious waterfront community in Dubai. Developed by Emaar Properties, one of the UAE's most prominent real estate developers, It offers a blend of residential, leisure, and retail spaces along the coastline of Dubai Harbour. 

It is a super luxury district, part of the larger Pam Jumeirah area. The beachfront apartments, penthouses, and villas in the community offer breathtaking sea views and white sands at Emaar Beachfront. The area's properties, including many branded residences,  are quite popular among homebuyers and investors, thanks to their upscale amenities and ideal location.

Spread over 10 million sq. ft., the gated island community is situated between Dubai Marina, JBR, and Palm Jumeirah. It provides residents easy access to the city's premier malls, dining venues, and yacht clubs.

The complex offers stylish apartments with 1-4 bedrooms, which offer spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf or the marina. The layouts of the residences are spacious and functional, the interior is made in loft style, there is a fully equipped kitchen, spacious bathroom, built-in closet, laundry room, open balcony, panoramic windows. Apartments with 2-4 bedrooms are complemented by walk-in closets.
